name: hud_ui_triplet_entries_copy_range
description: HudUiTripletEntries::CopyRange copies 0x50-byte scoreboard entries from a source range to a destination range and returns the advanced destination pointer.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent HUD triplet/list-menu source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4146a0 validates copying each 0x50-byte entry with a 0x14-dword copy loop, advancing source and destination by one entry, skipping writes for null destination, and returning the final destination pointer.
The native triplet scoreboard smoke forces triplet entry-vector growth beyond the initial capacity and verifies the copied 18-entry scoreboard vector and rendered top row remain correct.
